title: CURE: Cultural Understanding & Reasoning Evaluation – A Framework for “Thick” Culture Alignment Evaluation in LLMs
findings: Models exhibited poor performance in subgroup-sensitive reasoning, which includes religious contexts. The 'Specificity' metric, tested on the SpecNorm benchmark (of which 26.1% of items included religious cues), revealed that models struggle to ground cultural judgments in intersectional contexts like religion, often failing to reference relevant subgroup norms and instead relying on broad generalities.
